honesty: This ledger is a recorded scenario, replayed so the console can be read without a wallet. It is not live chain data and the addresses are illustrative. The classifier above does run live against the chain.

settlements.note: The ordinary case. Escrow opened, counterparty delivered, escrow released.

timeline.text: Escrow opened for 5.0 TSLA. Recovery address nominated.
Counterparty delivered the counter-asset.
Settled. Tokens released to the beneficiary.

settlements.note: Same desk, twenty minutes later. Nothing unusual.

timeline.text: Escrow opened for 12.0 AMZN.
Settled by the beneficiary.

settlements.note: Inside the force inclusion window. A transaction routed through the delayed inbox can still land, so this is genuinely unknown and must not be unwound.

timeline.text: Escrow opened for 40.0 PLTR.
Settlement transaction accepted but not yet sequenced. No receipt.
Window open. Waiting is the correct action, because unwinding now could double settle.

settlements.note: The case this contract exists for. The escrow is untouched and still open. Nothing was spent and nothing is recorded anywhere on chain.

timeline.text: Escrow opened for 8.0 NFLX.
Settlement rejected at the sequencer: Transaction rejected by chain policy.
No revert, no receipt, no event, no gas. Nothing to read on chain.
Nominate a clean recovery address while the escrow is still open, then let the window close.

settlements.note: A normal bridge deposit. ETH left Ethereum and the credit arrived on Robinhood Chain. This is what should happen.

timeline.text: 2.0 ETH deposited to the parent chain bridge contract.
Credit landed on Robinhood Chain.

settlements.note: Funds left the wallet on Ethereum and arrived nowhere. Arbitrum's own documentation describes this outcome and asks chain owners to account for it in a user communication strategy. No such accounting exists, which is why this row is the reason the monitor exists.

timeline.text: 1.5 ETH left the wallet and entered the parent chain bridge contract.
Deposit message queued to the delayed inbox.
No credit on Robinhood Chain.
Still no credit. One hour elapsed.
Window closed. The ETH is locked in the bridge with no corresponding child chain asset.
Monitor flagged the deposit, matched it against the child chain, and exported the evidence.
